title: Non-Monotone Response Modules and Cascades from the EML Operator for Reduced Models of Biological Dynamics
summary: Standard saturating response functions, such as the Hill function, are monotone and therefore cannot represent recruitment-induced overshoot or adaptive transients with a single block. Reproducing such non-monotone responses from saturating primitives requires at least a difference of two blocks with opposing amplitudes, doubling the static-block parameter count. Here, building on a recent mathematical result that a single binary operator, EML, generates all standard elementary functions, we use EML as a structured grammar for reduced nonlinear ODEs.
